decision: The norm-to-dynamic-FP8 boundary is now source-bound through the first real Gemma qkv_proj consumer and passes an exact-layout CPU/reference adapter. Advance only the specified producer-plus-consumer H200 discriminator when a future director authorizes GPU spend. Do not infer H200 or endpoint gain.

chain: apply_fp8_linear(input, weight, weight_scale, input_scale=None, bias, cutlass_fp8_supported=True)
sgl_kernel.fp8_scaled_mm(qinput, weight, x_scale, weight_scale, BF16, bias)

files.finding: qkv_proj is constructed with quant_config and is the first Gemma linear after input_layernorm.

Dynamic is the default activation scheme; BF16/FP16 inputs are supported; H200's non-block path forwards x, E4M3FN weight, FP32 weight scale, input_scale=None, optional bias, CUTLASS support, and per-token dynamic selection into apply_fp8_linear.

Input is viewed as contiguous 2D [M,K]; CUDA dynamic non-block quantization is per token; the first consumer receives qinput, weight, x_scale, weight_scale, input dtype, and bias and returns the original leading dimensions with N output columns.
The wrapper allocates E4M3FN qinput with the input shape and contiguous FP32 scales [M,1].

At M=384 on 132-SM H200 the small-batch path launches one 256-thread CTA per token, uses vec16 for K=8192, reloads BF16 input for quantization, sets scale=absmax/448 in FP32, explicitly clamps to [-448,448], casts to __nv_fp8_e4m3, and writes one FP32 scale per row.

The SM90 consumer requires row-major E4M3FN A, column-major E4M3FN B, matching K, 16-byte alignment, contiguous FP32 A scales with M elements, contiguous FP32 B scales with N elements, optional contiguous output-dtype bias, and BF16/FP16 output.
The pinned reference clamps scaled FP32 values to torch.float8_e4m3fn limits and converts to E4M3FN.

producer.scale_granularity: per token across all K=8192 elements
producer.scale_formula: FP32 absmax(row) / 448.0; no epsilon in the M=384 small-batch CUDA path
producer.quantization: BF16 value -> FP32, multiply by reciprocal scale, fminf/fmaxf clamp to [-448,448], convert through __nv_fp8_e4m3
producer.rounding: Pinned source delegates conversion rounding to the CUDA E4M3 constructor; the pinned test oracle uses torch.float8_e4m3fn conversion. The CPU adapter uses nearest representable E4M3FN with even-code tie breaking; exact CUDA tie bytes remain an H200 correctness row, not a measured local claim.
producer.saturation: finite saturation at E4M3FN maximum magnitude 448 before conversion
producer.zero_row_source_behavior: scale is +0.0; 1/scale is +inf; 0*inf reaches the fminf/fmaxf sequence as NaN and the source-equivalent adapter emits +448 code 0x7e. Because x_scale is zero, the consumer contribution is zero. Exact target binary bytes are required in the H200 discriminator.

first_real_consumer.call: fp8_scaled_mm(qinput, weight, x_scale, weight_scale, out_dtype=input.dtype, bias=bias)
first_real_consumer.activation_scale: contiguous FP32, M elements, source wrapper shape [384,1]
first_real_consumer.weight_scale: contiguous FP32, N elements, per output channel
first_real_consumer.bias: optional contiguous tensor with N elements and BF16 output dtype; qkv_proj forwards config.attention_bias

cpu_reference_adapter.adapter_contract: Both arms execute all 384x8192 activation elements. The consumer materializes full column-major logical weight storage for each N but uses a deterministic four-nonzero-per-column fixture so every one of the 6,291,456 local and 7,864,320 global outputs is tractable on CPU.
cpu_reference_adapter.timing_disposition: CPU elapsed times are implementation diagnostics only and are not H200 performance evidence.

physical_model.evidence_label: source-derived analytical; not measured traffic or latency
physical_model.hypothesis: A fused request-row RMSNorm plus per-token quantizer can compute sumsq and absmax together, make one output pass, remove the normalized BF16 materialization and one launch, and hand unchanged qinput/x_scale storage to qkv_proj.
physical_model.counter_prediction: one fewer producer launch, lower DRAM/L2 bytes over the fused range, same qkv GEMM bytes and tensor-core work; registers/spills must not reduce the qkv consumer's realized benefit
physical_model.transfer_limit: The 4.8 TB/s peak scale is not a latency prediction or upper bound. Cache residency and launch gaps require target measurement.

h200_discriminator.admission: No claim is allowed under the current zero-spend status. A future director must explicitly bind a compatible H200 component session.

fixture.input: contiguous BF16 [384,8192] with all-zero, constant-tiny, alternating-extreme, exact-halfway-rounding, saturation, and ordinary deterministic rows
fixture.weights: official qkv_proj parameter ABI with deterministic full local [8192,16384] and global [8192,20480] E4M3FN column-major tensors plus contiguous FP32 per-channel scales
fixture.bias: use the exact model config value and keep it identical across arms
fixture.process: fresh process; verify the module is Fp8LinearMethod and the loaded calls resolve to sgl_per_token_quant_fp8 plus SM90 fp8_scaled_mm

arms.name: stock
arms.execution: official input_layernorm(hidden_states) then official qkv_proj(hidden_states), capturing qinput/x_scale at the real producer-consumer boundary

arms.name: candidate
arms.execution: one fused request-row RMSNorm plus per-token E4M3FN producer that emits the identical qinput/x_scale ABI, followed by the unchanged layer weight, weight_scale, bias, SM90 fp8_scaled_mm, and qkv split

correctness.first_call: Run and synchronize each arm separately before any timed sweep; persist arm-specific completion markers.
producer_gate: bitwise-equal E4M3FN qinput for every finite fixture element
bitwise-equal FP32 x_scale for all 384 rows
explicitly report the zero row and every halfway/saturation row even if dequantized values agree
shape, stride, storage offset, alignment, dtype, and loaded-symbol identity match
consumer_gate: unchanged qkv_proj BF16 output shape for local and global geometry
bitwise-equal BF16 output when producer bytes/scales match
otherwise report max absolute error, relative L2, cosine error, and the first divergent row/column

timing.protocol: profiler off, warm caches, at least 7 alternating stock/candidate pairs per local/global geometry, CUDA events on the same stream, seeded 10000-resample paired bootstrap
timing.counters_after_timing: Only launch-gap union, DRAM bytes, L2 hit rate, registers, spills, achieved occupancy, and grid waves for the fused producer and unchanged qkv GEMM.

h200_discriminator.promotion_rule: Promote only if every producer and consumer gate passes and the paired interval for combined producer-plus-qkv latency excludes zero in the beneficial direction for both local and global geometry without a qkv regression.
negative_rules: typed source/binary negative if target sgl_per_token_quant_fp8 bytes contradict the pinned source-derived ABI
typed semantic negative for any scale, rounding, saturation, layout, bias, or BF16 consumer mismatch
typed physical negative if correctness passes but either combined geometry is not faster or saved boundary bytes do not reduce measured traffic/critical time
h200_discriminator.endpoint_transfer: No endpoint, quality, or 20% campaign claim follows from this component; a later matched endpoint A/B is required.
